messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx errors from model-runner-prod (us-west-2) starting at 2026-03-14T12:13:09Z. Error rate: 18% over baseline. Paging on-call.
eli: on it. looking at dashboards now.
eli: @ops-bot can you confirm if any infra events in us-west-2? CPU/GPU eviction alerts?
ops-bot: No scheduled maintenance. No infra autoscaler actions in last 30m. GPU memory pressure trend increasing on a subset of nodes.
sophie: i'm the secondary oncall, jumping in. eli — can you post the failing request patterns?
eli: sending a log tail. repeated stacktrace from model-runner:
```
2026-03-14T12:12:57Z model-runner ERROR segmentation fault (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f.., pid=4221
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ... nvptx_kernel.cu+0x12f
  ... runtime/kv_cache.c:245
```
Also OOM messages on the same pods right before segfaults.
maya: noticed increased batch sizes in the router for long-context chats. batch_size distribution shifted to the right ~x3.
dan: that matches a recent rollout — we pushed batching optimizer 2.4 -> 2.5 to prod ~30m ago. Could be related.
eli: good catch. can we rollback that optimizer config for affected pool?
sophie: yes, we can. initiating config rollback for model-pool-usw2-batched -> optimizer=2.4. @deploy-bot start rollback.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rollback-1832506820 to optimizer=2.4. ETA ~90s.
eli: also enabling circuit-breaker for model-runner-prod to reject oversized batches: `model.routing.max_batch_tokens=80` and lower concurrency to prevent queuing.
maya: switching router config to prefer fallback model (quantized-small) for requests > 1024 tokens to reduce GPU memory.
dan: is there an immediate mitigation to reduce customer impact? can we fail fast for largest requests?
sophie: putting a temporary request-size limit on the public API: 8k -> 4k tokens with 429 on exceed, for 20m window.
cs-team: heads up — customers AegisAI and MonarchTech reported degraded responses. Preparing an incident blast.
eli: rollback completed. Some pods restarted. Observed fewer OOM logs but still occasional segfaults on older nodes.
ops-bot: automated node health check: 3 nodes show driver-level GPU resets in last 10m. Marking them for evacuation.
eli: evacuating affected nodes and cordoning them. `kubectl drain node/gpu-usw2-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
maya: draining unblocks new pods on healthy nodes but capacity is tight. spinning up 2 more instances (g4dn-highmem equivalent) in us-west-2 now.
deploy-bot: scale-up job started: +2 gpus to pool-dedicated-usw2. ETA 180s.
dan: if segfaults persist after rollback and drain, we should suspect a kernel-level driver regression or a particular CUDA/torch wheel version paired with optimizer 2.5.
eli: agreed. capturing core dump and libcuda versions from the crashing container: `/var/crash/core.4221`, `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv`
sophie: core uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1832506789/core.4221.gz
eli: metrics trending — 5xx rate dropped from 18% to 6% after rollback + drain. still above baseline (0.5%).
cs-team: sending interim customer note: "We're investigating elevated error rates for model inference in us-west-2. We've applied mitigations; some customers may see reduced throughput. We'll update in 30 minutes." — sending now.
ops-bot: new nodes healthy, pods relocated. scaling completed.
eli: monitoring for 10 more minutes. If steady <1% we'll close paging and open a postmortem task.
maya: adding playback test to the canary harness to reproduce long-context batches with optimizer=2.5.
dan: logging an issue with ML infra: potential unsafe batching interaction with kernel-level memory management. tagging @eng-runtime @eng-ml.
eli: we should mark incident severity P2 — customer impact limited after mitigation but service degraded.
sophie: agreed. creating incident ticket P2 -> INC-2026-0314-01 and assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml for root cause analysis.
eli: final checklist: rollback applied, nodes drained, extra capacity added, request-size limit temporary, customer comm sent, core dump collected.
cs-team: will follow up with customers in 1h with deeper update.
eli: closing active paging in 15m if no regression. thanks all for fast coordination. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident state changed: Paging resolved (acknowledged) by eli at 2026-03-14T12:23:20Z. Incident ticket INC-2026-0314-01 created.
